subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved as docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline insertion exists through pi-tui, but exposing configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add public config or CLI surface under the repo's high bar for new knobs.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs/web/tui.md and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's shipped newline support as enough and intentionally decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs/web/tui.md and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed this exact docs-versus-config decision in the issue and has the strongest current TUI routing signal.
